description: Phase 1 feature ablation log — South America Stage 2 LambdaRank

entries.notes: Colombia dev (8 test groups), LambdaRank W9a, neg_ratio=100. Phase 0 final. Engine and neg_ratio locked from this result.
SA mini-sample validation gate (4M rows, 156 training groups, 61 test groups). Confirms mini-sample is a valid proxy for feature experiments.
baseline 79-feature mini-sample proxy; Euler gate confirmed full SA results
added eco_protection_ratio_lag1 + eco_protection_gap_lag1 (time-varying, from WDPA+GSN)
added dist_redd_km from ID-RECCO centroids (232 SA projects)
NDCG@5% early stopping: change k=1.0->5.0 to align objective with Recall@5% bar. REVERTED: best_iter=20 (undertrained), Lift@1% collapsed 15.34x->5.38x. Recall gap is structural, not objective.
pixel-level above-ground biomass (agb_tonne_ha) from ESA CCI Biomass; REDD+ financial incentive signal; pixel-level, not aggregate
baseline retrain with save-model for SHAP audit
drop bottom-30 SHAP features (ranks 50-79): redundant WorldClim bands, raw vs smoothed duplicates, zero-gradient policy/momentum features
baseline year_weights on mini-sample
group-norm weights 1/n_pos — equalises gradient across all expansion events
group-norm weights 1/sqrt(n_pos) — gentler equalisation
H6: Recall@5% early stopping; year_weights unchanged; W9a on
H6+H1b: Recall@5% earlystop + inv_sqrt_npos group weights; W9a on
H6+H1b+H3: Recall@5% earlystop + inv_sqrt_npos + W9a off
H6+H1b+H5: Recall@5% earlystop + inv_sqrt_npos + no rank normalisation
H6+H1b+H2: Recall@5% earlystop + inv_sqrt_npos + binary labels (0/1)
H6+H1b+H5+H2: Recall@5% earlystop + inv_sqrt_npos + no rank norm + binary labels
H10: combined ndcg_at_1pct x recall_at_5pct stopping; inv_sqrt_npos; rank-norm on
H5+H10: no rank norm + combined ndcg×recall stopping; inv_sqrt_npos
H8+H10: inv_sqrt_npos_temporal weights + combined ndcg×recall stopping
H5+H8+H10: no rank norm + temporal+size weights + combined ndcg×recall stopping

full_sa_experiments.notes: 79 features, baseline params (truncation=741, lr=0.081, n_est=446), YEAR_WEIGHT_MIN=0.5 default, W9a eco groups

20-trial full SA Optuna retune found truncation=84, lr=0.031, n_est=1133. Catastrophic: best_iter=7 (effectively untrained). Truncation=84 too small — noisy NDCG@1% callback fired on iter-7 fluctuation.

Reverted to baseline params (truncation=741). Dropped 12 low-z-score features (79->67): elevation_b2+smooths, elevation_b1_smooth4, powerplants_b2, GSN_b1+smooths, GSN_b5+smooths. YEAR_WEIGHT_MIN=0.2 (2001 gets 1/5 weight of 2013). Both changes net negative: Lift -7%, Recall -19%. Reverted.

full_sa_experiments.description: H6 (Recall@5% early stopping) + H1b (inv_sqrt_npos group-norm weights), W9a on, 79 features, baseline hyperparams
full_sa_experiments.verdict: NEW BEST — both metrics improved vs baseline (2.85x / 14.0%)
